sections.title: 7. Category-specific sections (shown conditionally, based on what the patient selects)

items.prompt: Full name
Date of birth
ID or passport number
Contact number and email
Height and weight
GP name and contact details (optional)

Tell us about your health in your own words — any conditions you're currently managing or have been diagnosed with in the past, any hospital admissions or surgeries, and anything else you think we should know.
Current medications — prescription, over-the-counter, and supplements (name, dose, frequency)
Known allergies — medications, food, other — and the reaction
Do you have any of the following diagnosed conditions? Heart disease / high blood pressure / diabetes / kidney disease / liver disease / thyroid disorder
Are there health conditions that run in your family — particularly heart disease, diabetes, prostate cancer, or other cancers? Tell us what you know, including age of onset if you know it.

Tell us about your day-to-day habits — smoking, alcohol, exercise, and any recreational drug or unsupervised steroid or peptide use. Honesty here helps us keep you safe, and everything you share is confidential.
How would you describe your mental health at the moment? Include any past or current diagnoses — for example depression or anxiety — and any medication you're on for this.
Over the last 2 weeks, have you had thoughts that you would be better off dead, or of hurting yourself in some way?
Tell us about your sexual health history — any STIs you've had in the past and whether they were treated, your last screening if you've had one, and anything currently on your mind.
Do you currently have any of the following symptoms: unusual discharge, sores, pain when urinating, or a new rash in the genital area?
Tell us about what you've been experiencing — how long it's been going on, whether it happens in some situations more than others, and whether you still get erections at other times (e.g. on waking).
Tell us about your hair loss — the pattern, whether it runs in your family, and anything you've tried before and how it went.
Tell us about your weight history — what you've tried before, including any prescription weight-loss medication, how it went, and anything about your relationship with food you think is relevant.
Tell us what's been going on — energy, libido, mood, sleep, or anything else — and whether you've used TRT before, prescribed or otherwise.
Tell us what you're hoping to achieve, any peptides you've used before, and whether you have any autoimmune conditions or a current or recent cancer diagnosis.
I confirm the information I've given is accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge.
I consent to a Meneer-affiliated doctor reviewing this information and prescribing treatment if appropriate.
Signature and date
